title: Configure scoped log access
summary: Grant required reader actions with supported scopes; test approved and unapproved identities.

blocks.text: CloudWatch Logs authorizes log-group and log-stream operations through IAM policies.
Grant the approved reader required read actions on intended log-group resources; remove unnecessary broader grants. Some operations require resource scope *.
Test intended read operations under approved and unapproved principals. Collecting logs does not itself grant reader access.

Test the supplied reader and unapproved principal for each intended operation. Keep identity, action and resource scope with results. Do not force resource scope narrower than the supplied operation supports.

blocks.takeaway: Collecting logs does not itself authorize a reader.
